CONTEXT_ONLY_rule: ONLY byte-identical duplicates among the FOUR CURRENT files. No predecessor-only, unchanged-but-unembedded, delta-only, reference-only or omitted body licenses acceptance. Each duplicate has exact source and canonical range/hash; parent must independently compare.
coverage_method: Token/byte ranges and existing cached range metadata ONLY, no AST or compilation of new sources. Every non-comment/non-layout Python token belongs to exactly one top-level definition or module-statement full region. This is packaging coverage, not behavioral verification.
empty_deltas: All comparisons recorded. An empty incremental delta never substitutes for a full current body; that full body is still embedded.
nonstatement_context: Blank lines, standalone comments and shebangs outside definition/statement bodies are not definitions/statements. Whole-source hashes bind them; all comments INSIDE full bodies are included verbatim.
ownership_rule: Every top-level/lexical definition instance and every module statement maps to exactly one owner. Each canonical atomic full current body is embedded verbatim once in its owner payload. Nested definitions inherit the full enclosing body owner.
parent_choice: FULL current bodies, 4-5 slices as needed, ceiling240000 B; delta-centric proposal rejected and not used.
stray_destination_check: Two explicit pa19-v6-v34-* globs returned no files before exclusive creation. Main stated ContinuePA19c stood down. No existing file overwritten/moved/deleted.
verification_boundary: Metadata/byte/token processing only; no target source exec/import/compile/AST, tests/native/probe/preflight or source-review launch in this packaging task. Parent independently verifies ownership and hashes before freezing reviews.
